reviewMethod: Provisional model-blind assistant visual review of 80 previously unreviewed nv_b recordings: 20 evenly spaced eligible numeric-ID positions in each available archive 01,02,03,06, after excluding every prior reviewed ID and known source hash including ambiguous/excluded decisions. Sequential OpenCV FFMPEG decoding, cv2.setNumThreads(1), one decoder and one decoder thread at a time. All timestamps are actual CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC readings checked finite and strictly increasing; nominal FPS never supplies timestamps. Direct view_image inspection of 20 screening contact sheets containing 960 timestamped frames. Nineteen candidate 0-4 s intervals received ordered evidence containing every source frame through the first PTS at or beyond 4 s: 2299 frames visually inspected; fifteen intervals retained. Full-size 320x180 tile pages are saved; five candidates inspected on those pages, fourteen on compact ordered 180x101 tile sheets. All 22 ambiguous recordings received six enlarged 640x360 samples each, 132 further frame presentations, inspected on eleven sheets. Static ordered frames only, no audio or continuous-motion playback. See visual-inspection-log.json and sampling logs for exact files, indices and timestamps.
limitations: Assistant labels are provisional, not human ground truth, continuous-motion playback, intent or impact verification. Every-frame static imagery still has blur, face masking, occlusion and finite spatial detail; fine contact and force may remain unresolved.

Only explicit 0-4 second source intervals are normal. Unannotated tails, uncertain contact, and all ambiguous/excluded clips remain unknown; an empty events array never means normal. No positive labels were assigned.

Props/weapons and prop-centred scenes are excluded. Background furniture and unused objects are not action labels. No filename or publisher category alone determined a decision; no classifier scores, model inference or training were used.

All VID records remain the single unresolved vid-v2-unresolved-session-cohort, training only. Descriptive sceneGroup values do not prove actor/session independence; zero calibration or holdout windows.

Selection is limited to 20 numeric-ID-stratified eligible clips per available nv_b archive. Visual triage favors visible hard ordinary movement; excluded quiet/prop scenes and unknown contact create selection bias. No target accepted count was imposed.

Full-clip sequential decoding checks timestamps but does not mean all full-clip frames were visually inspected. Full every-frame visual inspection applies only to the nineteen explicit candidate intervals; overview screening outside them is sparse.

Provenance uses existing pinned official Dataverse V2 records, matching cached archive byte sizes/MD5, extraction markers, archive member paths and source SHA256 values. No fresh online metadata lookup or independent participant-release audit was performed.

CC0 and participant consent are publisher/author-reported; complete non-copyright rights clearance is not established. Raw footage/evidence stays local and ignored, with no public exposure, deployment or production-performance claim.
Present-day RGB staged scenes, modest groups and repeated settings do not validate 50-100-person crowd recall, actual near-IR or real low-light CCTV operation.
